parse.title: Priest in Peril/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===The River Salve===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Drezel]] again.
*Go back down the trapdoor, through the monument room, and proceed through the eastern door. Talk to [[Drezel]].
*Give him 50 '''unnoted''' essence (this will take a few trips without using [[essence pouch|pouches]]).
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
